### A Faithful and Wise Servant
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/faithful-and-wise-servant
Passage: Matthew 24:45
Points:
- The exact time of Christ's return is known only to the Father.
- Normal daily routines will continue right until the sudden moment of judgment.
- Christ will arrive unexpectedly, just as a thief breaks in without warning.
- True preparedness is active service rather than passive waiting.
- Believers are urged to pursue holiness and diligent kingdom stewardship.

### Be Prepared for Jesus’ Return
Author: Michael A. Youssef
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-devotional-for-september-25-2026.html
Passage: Luke 12:40
Points:
- Expectation of Christ's return must guide how Christians live each day.
- Being dressed for service involves emotional, mental, and spiritual readiness.
- Keeping lamps alight means shining as faithful witnesses in a dark world.
- Getting distracted by worldly wealth and worries leaves people completely unprepared.
- Servants eagerly watching for the Master will receive eternal joy and reward.

### Day 169: Luke 12:35–40
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-169-luke-12-3540.html
Passage: Luke 12:36
Points:
- Jesus calls His followers to stay alert and carry out their assigned tasks.
- Date-setting is futile because Jesus will return at an unexpected moment.
- Keeping lamps burning resembles leaving a light on while lovingly waiting up for someone.
- Waiting for the Lord should be done in affectionate expectation rather than fear.
- Walking closely with Christ today ensures we will meet Him unashamed.

### Time with God - February 19
Author: Ambassadors for Christ International
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/timewithgod/time-with-god-february-19-2026.html
Passage: Luke 12:35-36
Points:
- Christians labor most diligently when they deeply care about the Master they serve.
- True servants remain faithful to their duties even when the Master is away.
- Faithful stewardship includes genuine care and concern for the souls of others.
- The way we handle our time and resources shows whether our hearts are truly watchful.
